overview_description.description:
Poppy is a modern childcare solution for modern families. We set your family up with a team of talented and thoroughly vetted sitters. Then you just text us when you need a sitter. Simple.

So you can get back to juggling dinners and dance recitals. Stop worrying about being stuck without care when you need it.
